title: The rain note in the Pump Station 4 manual
description: A 1986 maintenance manual recovered from municipal archive box 14B. A pencil note across section 4 reads, ‘Ignore this in rain. Valve sticks.’ A brown tide mark crosses the sentence.

title: Two deferred gasket requests
description: Two purchase requests for a $43.20 valve gasket, each stamped DEFER—NEXT QUARTER. The rain annotation appeared three weeks after the second denial, in a different hand.

title: Pump Station 4 annual incident ledger
description: A municipal incident ledger recording eleven rain-related shutdowns before the gasket replacement and none in the following reporting year.
